title: Recover a partial quality return without reversing a shared supplier payment
user_instruction: Two of the ten RAD-DOCK-40G docking stations failed the recorded incoming inspection after receipt. Return only those two units, complete the already approved replacement order for two RAD-DOCK-40G-R2 units, apply the supplier debit credit to the replacement invoice, and ensure the supplier pickup event is delivered exactly once. Preserve all eight good docks, all four RAD-DISPLAY-5K displays, the unaffected display invoice, and the submitted shared Payment Entry.

ambiguous_operation.operation: submit the draft partial Purchase Return
ambiguous_operation.surface_result: HTTP connection lost before a success response
